Definition: Tola, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Tola = "worm"; 1) the 1st born of Issachar and progenitor of the family of Tolaites; 2) a man of Issachar, son of Puah and judge of Israel after Abimelech
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
